title: CI: rtl-fast firmware-unit runs at 2450 of 2700 s; split or shorten it to restore headroom
body:
Found by the #697 reviews (R585-4-S1, R584-4-S2, carried in R585-5 on PR #705). The hosted `rtl-fast` job `firmware-unit` runs close to its 45-minute timeout on every branch.

## Measurements

- At PR #705 head `92b5be18` (job 114282060753), the job took 2450 s of its 2700 s, a 9.3 % margin. Step 8 took 1933 s and the boundary step 113 s.
- Across 33 recent hosted runs on all branches, the job took 1428 to 2489 s. Dev itself ranged from 1551 to 2250 s, and branches without #697's change reached 2468 s.

The margin is runner variance shared by every lane. Any lane adding a few minutes to this job turns it red at random.

## Acceptance

1. Measure the job's steps on hosted runs and name the steps that cost the time.
2. Bring the job to at most 70 % of its timeout on the slowest of 10 consecutive hosted runs, without removing any check, arm or coverage ratchet. Split it into parallel jobs that the `rtl-fast` aggregate requires, or shorten steps with a stated bound.
3. `scripts/ci_events.py` pins the new job layout, and `docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md` records the per-job budget.
